mapper.select: SELECT id, start_streak_day, decay_percent, effective_from, effective_to, version_no FROM growth_point_decay_rule WHERE status = 'ENABLED' AND start_streak_day <= #{streakDays} AND effective_from <= #{awardedAt} AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to > #{awardedAt}) ORDER BY start_streak_day DESC, version_no DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, student_id, last_activity_at, reminder_due_at, clear_due_at, last_reminder_created_at, last_cleared_at, version_no FROM growth_point_dormancy_state WHERE student_id = #{studentId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT MAX(activity.occurred_at) FROM ( SELECT event.occurred_at FROM learn_task_assignment_event event JOIN learn_task_assignment assignment ON assignment.id = event.assignment_id WHERE assignment.student_id = #{studentId} AND event.event_type IN ('CLAIMED', 'PAUSED', 'RESUMED', 'ABANDONED', 'CHECKED_IN', 'REVIEW_APPROVED', 'EXEMPTED') UNION ALL SELECT ledger.occurred_at FROM growth_point_ledger ledger WHERE ledger.student_id = #{studentId} AND ledger.change_type <> 'DORMANCY_CLEAR' UNION ALL SELECT supplement.supplemented_at FROM growth_review_supplement supplement JOIN growth_review review ON review.id = supplement.review_id WHERE review.student_id = #{studentId} ) activity

SELECT parent_user_id FROM edu_parent_student WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND relation_role = 'PRIMARY_GUARDIAN' AND primary_scope_key = 'PRIMARY' ORDER BY effective_from DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO growth_point_dormancy_state ( id, student_id, last_activity_at, reminder_due_at, clear_due_at, version_no, created_at, updated_at ) SELECT #{studentId}, #{studentId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, TIMESTAMPADD(DAY, 27, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), TIMESTAMPADD(DAY, 30, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM growth_point_dormancy_state WHERE student_id = #{studentId} )
mapper.select: SELECT state.student_id FROM growth_point_dormancy_state state WHERE state.student_id > #{afterId} AND ((state.reminder_due_at <= #{now} AND state.last_reminder_created_at IS NULL) OR (state.clear_due_at <= #{now} AND state.last_cleared_at IS NULL) OR (state.last_cleared_at IS NOT NULL AND ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM learn_task_assignment_event event JOIN learn_task_assignment assignment ON assignment.id = event.assignment_id WHERE assignment.student_id = state.student_id AND event.occurred_at > state.last_activity_at AND event.event_type IN ('CLAIMED', 'PAUSED', 'RESUMED', 'ABANDONED', 'CHECKED_IN', 'REVIEW_APPROVED', 'EXEMPTED') ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM growth_point_ledger ledger WHERE ledger.student_id = state.student_id AND ledger.occurred_at > state.last_activity_at AND ledger.change_type <> 'DORMANCY_CLEAR' ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM growth_review_supplement supplement JOIN growth_review review ON review.id = supplement.review_id WHERE review.student_id = state.student_id AND supplement.supplemented_at > state.last_activity_at ) ))) ORDER BY state.student_id LIMIT #{limit}
